warnings.description: 46 nodes lack summary/description/purpose fields, making them opaque in the knowledge graph
warnings.recommendation: Add summary/description to these nodes, especially the function nodes and type definitions which are important for understanding code relationships

warnings.description: 125 nodes have no edges connecting them to the rest of the graph, limiting discoverability

breakdown.description: All 11 JSON schema data files (armors.json, blades.json, etc.) are orphaned despite being imported by engine/data modules
breakdown.description_config: vercel.json is orphaned despite being referenced in build pipeline
breakdown.description_interface: TypeScript interfaces/types from types.ts (Race, Guild, Armor, etc.) lack edges despite being used extensively
breakdown.description_constant: Individual constant nodes (BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE, MAX_LEVEL, etc.) lack edges despite being referenced by function nodes
breakdown.description_function: Functions like getOrkTenacityBuffs, calcOrkTenacityBonus lack edges despite being exported and used

warnings.recommendation: Add import/use edges for schema nodes to their importer modules, and for individual constants to the functions that use them

warnings.description: 65 nodes use 'file' field while 215 use 'filePath' field for the same purpose
warnings.recommendation: Standardize to 'filePath' field name across all node types for consistency

warnings.description: 21 function nodes use '__nofilepath__' in their ID instead of the actual file path, making them unlocatable
warnings.recommendation: Replace __nofilepath__ with the actual file path prefix (e.g., function:src/lib/store.ts:setEnchantment)

warnings.description: Edge type naming is inconsistent: 'import' (14 edges) vs 'imports' (104 edges), 'depends_on' (10 edges) vs 'depends-on' (3 edges)

examples.importVsImports: module:src/data/statboost.ts uses type='import' while module:src/data/DoTDamage.ts uses type='imports'
examples.dependsOnVsDependsOn: file:src/lib/engine/build.ts uses type='depends_on' while file:result uses type='depends-on'

warnings.recommendation: Normalize edge types to use hyphens consistently (imports, depends-on) or underscores consistently (imports, depends_on)

warnings.description: Some nodes use unusual ID prefixes that mix multiple conventions: 'file:type::', 'file:interface::', 'file:const::'
warnings.recommendation: Use the standard prefix pattern: 'type::', 'interface::', 'constant::' without the 'file:' prefix

suggestions.description: Add import edges from engine/data modules (character.ts, equipment.ts, weapons.ts) to their corresponding schema JSON nodes (races.json, armors.json, blades.json, etc.)
suggestions.impact: Would connect 11 currently orphaned schema nodes to the dependency graph

suggestions.description: Add 'exports' edges from the barrel module (module:src/lib/types.ts) to each type/interface constant node, and 'imports' edges from consumer modules
suggestions.impact: Would connect ~40 orphaned type/constant nodes to the type definition barrel and their consumers

suggestions.description: Add 'calls' edges for remaining orphaned function nodes that are called by other functions but lack edge representation
suggestions.impact: Would improve accuracy of the call graph
examples: getOrkTenacityBuffs and calcOrkTenacityBonus should have edges from their callers
getDraconicInfusionDurMult and getDraconicAbilityDebuffs should have edges from modules that use them

suggestions.description: The 'unused-reference' edge type (4 edges) should be merged into the regular 'imports' type with lower weight, or documented as intentionally marking unused imports
The graph currently has no cycle detection. Consider adding a check for circular import chains which could indicate architectural issues
suggestions.potentialCycleRisk: BuffData.ts <-> Perkbasedmg.ts (Perkbasedmg imports from DoTDamage which imports from constants that BuffData also imports)
